field: the same current locally finite divergence-free field, cutoff sequence, supports, gauges, fixed profile, same-choice projectors and weighted inverse maps
correction: carry the two additional A0/A1 source derivatives required by the extra compact integration into the exact residual comparison stage
reserve_accounts: separate A0 and A1 source reserves h*kappa, one-stage regular reserve h*(1/2-3*kappa), and the existing first-omitted cutoff half-gain; no account pays another class's logarithm
residual: retain time, unit viscosity, full pressure, old-new, new-old and new-square with all six covariance entries and actual axial velocity
quantifier: for each fixed jet and target choose one finite comparison stage and its finite enlarged source requests; no stage-uniform constant or fixed-q contraction is used
scope: conditional current-chain local residual flatness only; corner, endpoint, localization, force, energy, comparison, exclusion and blow-up are not replayed here
